name: PARAMON
recent: PARAMON 近期完成多项企业活动，包括以 RM75 million 出售位于槟城的教育大楼、完成脱售 University of Wollongong Malaysia 剩余 30% 股权，以及以 RM113.5 million 完成收购雪兰莪 Bukit Raja 约 48.489 英亩土地。公司也发布了最新季度业绩，并有多项董事及大股东持股变动申报。
notable: 以 RM75 million 现金完成出售位于槟城 Jalan Anson 的教育大楼。
完成出售 University of Wollongong Malaysia 剩余 30% 股权，代价 RM6.645 million。
以 RM113.5 million 现金完成收购雪兰莪 Bukit Raja 三块毗邻租赁地契土地，总面积约 48.489 英亩。
risks: 首席财务官 Foong Poh Seng 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日至 10 月 1 日在公开市场增持公司股份。
董事 Chew Sun Teong 及 Benjamin Teo Jong Hian 以及大股东 Benjamin Teo Jong Hian 于 2026 年 9 月有多项持股变动申报。

news.title: Paramount expects sales momentum to continue into fourth quarter

recent_en: PARAMON recently completed several corporate exercises, including the disposal of an education campus in Penang for RM75 million, the completion of the sale of its remaining 30% stake in University of Wollongong Malaysia, and the completion of the acquisition of approximately 48.489 acres of land in Bukit Raja, Selangor for RM113.5 million. The company also released its latest quarterly results and had several director and substantial shareholder dealings.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of an education campus at Jalan Anson, Penang, for RM75 million cash.
Completed the sale of its remaining 30% equity interest in University of Wollongong Malaysia for RM6.645 million.
Completed the acquisition of three contiguous leasehold land parcels in Bukit Raja, Selangor, totaling approximately 48.489 acres, for RM113.5 million cash.
risks_en: Chief Financial Officer Foong Poh Seng acquired shares in the open market on 30 September and 1 October 2026.
Directors Chew Sun Teong and Benjamin Teo Jong Hian, and substantial shareholder Benjamin Teo Jong Hian, had several shareholding change filings in September 2026.
